flags.question: Which movies released between 2005 and 2010 have the tagline 'Speed has no limits'?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.released >= 2005 AND m.released <= 2010 AND m.tagline = 'Speed has no limits'
RETURN m.title

flags.question: Which people have reviewed the movie with the highest votes?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WITH m
ORDER BY m.votes DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m)
RETURN p.name

flags.question: Show the top 5 movies that have been acted in by the oldest person in the database.
flags.cypher:
// Step 1: Find the oldest person in the database
MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p
ORDER BY p.born ASC
LIMIT 1

// Step 2: Find the movies that the oldest person has acted in
MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)
WITH m
ORDER BY m.votes DESC
LIMIT 5

// Step 3: Return the top 5 movies
RETURN m.title AS title, m.votes AS votes, m.released AS released
details: Cypher LIMIT 1 but TypeQL limit 5

flags.question: Retrieve the top five movies released in the 2000s that were either directed or produced by the same person.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED|PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE m.released >= 2000 AND m.released < 2010
WITH m, COUNT(p) AS person_count
ORDER BY m.votes DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS released, m.votes AS votes
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: List 3 persons who have acted in, directed, and produced at least one movie each.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie),
      (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie),
      (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m3:Movie)
WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) AS actedInCount, COUNT(DISTINCT m2) AS directedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT m3) AS producedCount
WHERE actedInCount > 0 AND directedCount > 0 AND producedCount > 0
RETURN p.name
LIMIT 3
